note:
Setlist not definitively known, and a whole set of it has no audio at all. Every recording catalogued on archive.org for this date is **set two only** — all four identifiers say so (sbd-set2, pset2) — so the first set is absent, and archive.org's own listing shows set two opened with Samson & Delilah and Sunrise, which no tape carries either. What survives is the ten songs here, from Ramble On Rose to the One More Saturday Night encore, timed from gd1977-10-07.170389.sbd.miller.flac1644; four of them Road Trips 1:2 also carries, and its timings stand for those.

It is here rather than in data/partial-shows/ for the reason 19731210 is: the missing songs are not waiting for a timing somebody can supply, they are waiting for a tape that does not circulate. Stripes are a claim about what was played and in what order, and for the first set that claim cannot be made at all.

Note the venue: this is University Arena (The Pit) at the University of New Mexico. Road Trips 1:2 draws on four nights across New Mexico, Oklahoma, Texas and Louisiana, and only the other three are named in the release's own per-track venue column.
